name: Translate texts into diverse non-English target languages
description: Users asked to translate various texts into specific target languages such as Korean, Russian, Portuguese, Turkish, and Vietnamese, often providing source material in English, French, Spanish, or Greek. Some requests additionally involved identifying the source language, preserving formatting elements, or adjusting for a specific tone or style.
